## Core Architecture & Engineering Philosophy

- **Scalable by Design**: Clean architecture and modular systems designed to handle high complexity and distributed loads.
- **Problem-Driven Development**: Building purposeful software with a strong focus on real-world reliability, performance, and long-term maintainability.
- **Automate Early**: Automating manual tasks through version-controlled scripts, Docker containers, and robust CI/CD pipelines.
- **Build for Visibility**: Implementing clear observability with proactive telemetry, logging, metrics, and alerting to ensure systems are easy to monitor and debug.

## Featured Projects

- [Crontab Text Explainer](https://nofil-zahid.github.io/crontab-text-explainer/): Open-source developer tool for visually interpreting, building, and explaining cron expressions. Built with React, TypeScript, and Vite. Source: https://github.com/nofil-zahid/crontab-text-explainer
- [SayBack](https://www.npmjs.com/package/sayback): Developer CLI tool that animates terminal output with a retro typewriter character-cycling effect. Distributed via npm. Source: https://github.com/nofil-zahid/sayback
- [DineDynaty](https://github.com/nofil-zahid/restaurant-management-system): Comprehensive mobile Restaurant Management System streamlining tables, reservations, and inventory. Built with Flutter and Firebase.
- [ClassHub](https://nofil-web-portfolio.vercel.app/projects/classhub): Role-based learning management system featuring real-time messaging, automated grading checks with Gemini API & Copyleaks API, and file tracking. Built with React, Express, MySQL, and Firebase.
- [Docly](https://nofil-web-portfolio.vercel.app/projects/docly): Extensible web document editor supporting rich-text blocks, keyboard shortcuts, and dynamic formatting. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Slate.js, and Tailwind CSS.

- Designed and built a multi-tenant SaaS architecture using Next.js and Express.js.
- Implemented PostgreSQL multi-schema architecture for complete tenant data isolation and scalable request routing.
- Integrated multi-party PayPal payment flows for subscription-based SaaS billing.
- Spearheaded UI component architectures and Firebase service integrations.

### MERN Stack Developer — Directorate of IT, GCUL (Nov 2023 – Jul 2025)
- Engineered full-stack modules and secured internal RESTful APIs for university management systems (HRM, SFC, ORUP, SRMS, and LMS).
- Built interactive HR reporting dashboards for academic and administrative staff.
- Implemented student clearance pipelines with automated fee and challan verification.
- Developed and deployed the departmental Dak Management System for tracking official physical file transitions.

## Key FAQs

- **What is your primary tech stack?**
  TypeScript across the entire stack. Next.js/React on the frontend; Node.js with Express or NestJS paired with PostgreSQL on the backend; Docker, Kubernetes, and GitHub Actions for infrastructure.
- **Do you handle end-to-end development?**
  Yes, from system architecture and database design to frontend UX and automated production deployments.
- **How do you ensure code quality?**
  Strict TypeScript typing, automated linting and formatting (ESLint, Prettier), Git commit hooks (Husky, lint-staged), and CI/CD validation before deployment.
- **Are you available for contract or full-time roles?**
  Yes, available for select contract projects and full-time opportunities.
